integrity: Finite exhaustive lower-bound search and independent explicit stabilizer enumeration for the four witness sets were executed. General upper-bound reasoning is algebraic. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only full-support binary dimension-five codes and coordinate-permutation automorphisms. No formula in other dimensions, no classification of all codes at each valid length. Earlier unindexed length-spectrum work remains possible, and the 2015 article full text was not available.
title: The complete length spectrum of asymmetric binary dimension-five codes
